I have 1.3 hectares here in Mtwara where I grow maize to feed my family. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or hybrid seeds, so I use manure from our animals and seed I saved from last season. My children and I will work the land with hand hoes, and I will hire a few workers to help with weeding when the rains come.
